sections.text:
One day, Juha decided to go to the market in the nearby city to buy some groceries.

Juha was accompanied on this trip by his young son, and they took with them their donkey to carry the luggage upon return.

At the beginning of the road, Juha rode the donkey and his son walked beside him holding the reins.

They passed a group of people, and Juha heard one of them say: “Look at this cruel man! He rides the donkey and leaves his young son walking tired!”

Juha felt ashamed, so he got off the donkey and mounted his son in his place, and he walked beside him.

After a short distance, they passed another group of people, and one of them said: “Look at this rebellious generation! The strong young man is riding the donkey, while his old father is walking!”

The son was upset by these words, so he got off the donkey, and the two decided to walk together behind the donkey.

But it was not long before they passed by other men who laughed and said: “How ignorant I am of these two! They walk on their feet and get tired, while the donkey walks comfortably without any load!”

Juha stood confused, not knowing what to do to please the people.

Juha thought for a while, then said to his son: “We have no choice but to ride the donkey, the two of us.”

Juha and his son rode together on the back of the poor donkey, which began to stagger under their heavy weight.

They passed through a small village, and a passer-by shouted to them: “You are so cruel-hearted! Do you not have mercy on this poor animal? You almost broke its back!”

Juha and his son quickly got out and sat on the side of the road, thinking about a solution to this difficult problem.

Juha said to his son while sighing: “I rode Flamona, you rode Flamona, we walked together Flamona, and we rode together Flamona!”

The son replied: “Dad, there is nothing left for us to do but carry the donkey on our backs!”

Juha laughed and said: “This is the only remaining solution to satisfy these people!”

Juha and his son tied the donkey's feet with a rope, carried him on a long plank and placed it on their shoulders.

When they entered the market carrying the donkey, people gathered around them, laughing hysterically.

Finally, Juha realized an important lesson, and he said to his son: “Listen, my son, pleasing people is an unattainable goal, so do what you think is right and do not pay attention to what others say!”

They unloaded the donkey, mounted Juha, and returned to their village convinced of this great wisdom.
